ArcadeDB Graphalytics Benchmarks

Performance history for ArcadeDB on the LDBC Graphalytics and LSQB benchmark suites, updated weekly by CI.

Mode 1 — Official LDBC Graphalytics

The official LDBC Graphalytics framework, reloading the graph per algorithm for isolated load/processing time measurements (datagen-7_5-fb).

Mode 2 — ArcadeDB Embedded

A standalone embedded-Java run: load once, build the Graph Analytical View once, run all six algorithms (datagen-7_5-fb).

Mode 3 — LSQB Embedded

Nine subgraph pattern-matching queries (Q1–Q9) against LDBC SNB social network data (SF0.1).
Generated by .github/workflows/arcadedb-benchmark.yml.
